title: WhatsApp Introduces Guest Calling Feature
excerpt: WhatsApp now lets users invite anyone to a call using a link, eliminating the need for guests to have an account or the app.
body_html:
WhatsApp has introduced a new guest calling feature that allows users to invite individuals to calls without requiring them to create an account or download the application.

By sending a direct call link, participants can join conversations easily. This functionality utilizes Meta's web version support for calls, which was introduced earlier this year, enabling browser-based participation for invited guests.
